    First Block with Julianna Lamb, Co-Founder and CTO of Stytch

    By Anastasia Crew

    Startup Marketing Lead

    1 min read
    Share this post

    Uh-oh! It looks like your ad blocker is preventing the video from playing.

    Please watch it on YouTube

    Listen to First Block on your favorite podcast platform.

    Download Stytch’s product roadmap tracker and recruiting tracker. To learn more about how Notion is supporting startups, please visit notion.com/startups.

    Welcome to First Block, a Notion series where founders and executives from the world's leading companies tell us about the many “firsts” of their startup journeys. Hosted by our Co-founder and COO Akshay Kothari, this series explores the many ups and downs that founders face as they build their companies, and what they've learned along the way.

    In our second episode, we spoke with Julianna Lamb, Co-founder and CTO of Stytch. Stytch helps developers secure and scale their applications with authentication and fraud prevention.

    In this episode, we do a deep-dive into:

    • How Stytch came to be (and why)

    • The importance of understanding your customers’ needs

    • Why a structured hiring process matters

    • The value of a strong co-founder relationship

    • What to think about when building your team

    What’s in this episode:

    • 00:00: Intro

    • 01:02: Origin Story

    • 05:05: Getting to Product-Market-Fit

    • 08:38: Fundraising

    • 10:33: Co-Founder Relationship

    • 14:16: Building EPD Teams

    • 27:52: Evolving Role of CTO

    • 32:08: GTM Partnership

    • 38:54: Open Source

    • 40:01: Day in the Life of Julianna Lamb
